odc_type: Inconsistent Exception Handling / API Contract Violation
observation_summary: The application throws an IllegalArgumentException instead of the expected ClassCastException when adding non-comparable objects to a Frequency instance.
reasoning_summary: The Frequency class uses a TreeMap to store values, which requires keys to be Comparable. The addValue(Object v) method catches ClassCastException and rethrows it as an IllegalArgumentException. This is problematic because the first insertion of a non-comparable object succeeds (as the TreeMap is empty and no comparison is performed), but subsequent operations fail. The test case expects a ClassCastException to be thrown immediately when a non-comparable object is added, but the current implementation masks this by catching the exception and throwing a different one, leading to inconsistent state and API behavior.
